title: Synthetic database connection timeout
summary: Synthetic database timeout alert for benchmark; no database is contacted by this fixture.
evidence: Ground truth: application connection attempts to the isolated benchmark database endpoint exceed the configured connection timeout. Dependency: benchmark-postgres. Error class: SQLTransientConnectionException. No credentials or customer records.

ground_truth.root_cause: The application cannot acquire a database connection before its configured timeout, due to the benchmark database dependency being unavailable or too slow.
